adversarial_audit.objection: Non-rich triples can dominate the weighted burden.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Three-signature triples retain exactly 4/g^5. The only 2/g^4 term has only 3(N-2) ordered occurrences and only one-dimensional targets, leaving total ratio O(1/g).

adversarial_audit.objection: A per-vertex Markov bound cannot survive a union over N vertices.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Apply Markov once to the complete global relation Gram; global burden and global domain both acquire the same N factor.

adversarial_audit.objection: Heavy support pressure contradicts a relation bulk edge.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Support pressure ignores principal-correlation squares. Fourth-power carrier rank weighting changes Z4^2/g^7 to g^2/g^7.

adversarial_audit.objection: Vanishing relation outlier rank alone proves a complete PGM sampler.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Relation trim has exactly zero ideal signal loss, but an unrepresented relation image can leave spurious cokernel directions. Recursive completeness and coherent access remain open.

claim_gate.reason: The complete pair-relation Gram has a vanishing coefficient-rank outlier sector and relation trim is signal-free, but recursive cokernel completeness, endpoint shorts, and coherent decoding remain unresolved.

falsifiers_triggered: Raw support overlap is not the correct spectral burden statistic.
Non-rich orientation triples do not restore a macroscopic weighted burden.
A global first-moment argument suffices for bulk rank but not for an untrimmed edge.
Signal-free relation trimming does not by itself compile the full synthesis cokernel projector.

proof_obligations.resolution: The carrier sums factor by membership block; exhaustive small-n controls match 4/g^5 and the two-signature exception.
All valid signature supports are counted. The only larger per-star term occurs on 3(N-2) ordered pairs and remains O(1/g).
Pair-rank concentration supplies the denominator; a single conditioned Markov inequality controls the global burden.
The exact relation-cokernel theorem gives D_0 D_1=0, so every retained or removed relation-image subspace has exactly zero ideal PGM polar amplitude.
Frobenius control permits a vanishing-rank outlier sector; dropping its image can leave unresolved synthesis-kernel directions unless recursive completeness is compiled.

summary: Proved that exact carrier-correlation weights overcome the divergent affine support pressure: the complete collision-free pair-relation Gram has only a vanishing coefficient-rank outlier sector, whose relation image is exactly signal-free.

theorem_contract.balanced_domain_floor: Uniform pair-core multiplicity concentration lower-bounds the global coefficient domain by N B_K(1-eta)^3/|S_n|^3 times physical ambient dimension.
theorem_contract.collision_free_bulk_edge: One global Markov bound after collision-free conditioning gives O(|S_n|^-1/2) failure and relative outlier rank for the fixed window around relation eigenvalue 2.
theorem_contract.global_relation_gram_identity: For the complete pair-common boundary Gram G, every diagonal block is 2I and E||G-2I||_F^2/dim(H_phys)=N mu_nu.
theorem_contract.scope: This is a coefficient-rank bulk theorem, not an untrimmed minimum edge, complete-cokernel projector, decoder, or speedup.
theorem_contract.signature_conditioned_star_burden: Every valid three- or four-signature orientation star has exact expected normalized squared Hilbert-Schmidt overlap 4/|S_n|^5; a two-signature star contributes 2/|S_n|^4 only for a one-dimensional target.
